name: Andean cock-of-the-rock
desc: A cloud-forest bird of ravines and streams. It eats mostly fruit plus insects, and its leks attract predators such as jaguars and ocelots.
about: The Andean cock-of-the-rock, also known as tunki (Quechua), is a large passerine bird of the cotinga family native to Andean cloud forests in South America. It is the national bird of Peru.
